result:
Round 156 (V-2b-3a) is implemented and ready for C's browser checks. A ran no browser rows, so nothing visual is confirmed yet.

**What changed (12 paths: 10 modified, 2 new, all within the grant)**
- `strings.ts` now has `StudioTimeTextPart` and `studioTimeTextParts` (`rangeReadout`, `selectedClipDetail`). The existing `studioWorkspaceStrings` builders are built from those parts, so their text is byte-identical and the object still has its 7 keys.
- The new `ArrangementTimeText.tsx` returns a fragment. Timecodes render in a span with `font-mono font-normal tabular-nums`; the rest is plain text. It renders no element of its own, so forwardRef doesn't apply (I read `FORWARDREF_COMPONENT.md`).
- Timecodes are now in mono spans at all 6 sites:
  - the range readout and selected-clip line (`StudioWorkspace`);
  - the library drop ghost and the all-tracks lane label (`ArrangementLane`; the N6 lane-move ghost is untouched);
  - the clip range badge (`ArrangementClip`);
  - the video-gap time (`ArrangementVideoDock`; its `ref` and live text update are unchanged).
- New tests: ST-TP1–3, TH11, WSU3–5, and two extra assertions in CSU1. Doc 125 changed only its status line; doc 126 is new, in Georgian.

**Checks actually run**
- Start state matched: HEAD `4c07d5f`, clean tree, the 963 frozen files and the 10 start hashes all OK.
- Vitest on 34 files: 569/569 before, 576/576 after. None of the neighbouring tests B listed turned red.
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` passed. Lint shows 218 warnings, the same count as round 155. Biome on the 10 code and test files is clean.
- All four mutations (m143–m146) turned the expected tests red, and each was restored with its hash checked. I re-ran m145 after the review fix below.
- At the end: the 963 frozen files are unchanged, the diff on protected files is empty (Export dialog, `studio-lab.tsx` and `app.css` included), and `git status` shows exactly 10 modified + 2 new.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent ran (score 8.5/10). It had no shell, so it read the current files rather than the diff.
- **Medium, fixed:** ST-TP1 compared the code with itself. It now checks literal strings and fails under m145.
- **Lows left for B:**
  - TH11 only counts class strings in the source; the drop-ghost and video-gap spans have no DOM test (those tests would need files I don't own).
  - WSU3 checks a prefix, as the spec asks.
  - Mono digits are wider, so badges on short clips may cut off sooner. The LAYOUT-FIT row covers this.
- **Architecture note for B (keep for now):** the theme test keeps per-file class-count tables, which every class tweak has to edit. A later bounded task could replace them with per-site DOM assertions.

The report files in the loop folder were partly updated with shell commands rather than Edit/Write; no store file was edited that way.

**Not run by A:** the full test suite, `verify`, build, e2e, and every browser row. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are false.

**Next for C:** all §4 rows (T156-TARGETED through PX-NET/REG-HYD). T156-TARGETED should see 34 files, 576/576.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- a-round-156.md
- a-round-156-result.json
- a-round-156/ (test runs, mutations, end-sha256.txt, diff-vs-start.patch, code-review.md)
